opening.argument: This is a sustained warning and critical examination of BitConnect’s lending model, not an endorsement. The speaker explicitly frames the discussion as a warning: “I want to give you guys a huge warning on this.” He examines the unusually high projected returns, locked principal, and affiliate incentives while questioning whether those returns are realistic. Although he acknowledges that he could make substantial money promoting BitConnect, he explains that he will not do so because he expects the arrangement to collapse and people to lose money. His stated purpose is unambiguous: “I'm trying to wave you off.” Any conditional mention that viewers could still join through his link is subordinate to that repeated caution and discouragement, rather than functioning as a promotion.

citations.quote: I want to give you guys a huge warning on this
I don't feel good about doing it, because I think eventually this is going to collapse and a lot of people are going to lose a lot of money.
But I'm just trying to keep it real here. I'm trying to wave you off.
